_doc: THE LOAD LAW budget for scripts/check-page-load.mjs (pnpm check:page-load). neverOnLoad: relations fetched only by the thing that shows them, when it opens — never during a page load on any route. routes.<route>.repeats: SHRINK-ONLY allowance for distinct reads of one relation (e.g. an IN list split into chunks), keyed 'op schema.relation'. Never raise a number to get green: find why it repeats. routes.<route>.mustRead: relations the page SHOWS and so must load (an on-demand relation listed here is allowed on that route).

_allowances.rpc platform.knob_snapshot_delta: the notes list's landing-tab knob is read before the organization resolves (holding it would delay the list); the shell's readers use the org address
_allowances.select iam.organizations / rpc public.mb: one read split into IN-list chunks of 100 organizations
_allowances.rpc public.assoc_for_sources: three different reads: the list's notes, the visible notes' scope tags, the project tags
_allowances.select platform.assists: three different selects (undecided keys, silenced keys, approvals count); on dashboard and shapes: two different selects (pending approvals, silenced keys)
_allowances.select workbench.notes: the list select and the ids-only select behind the scope tags
_allowances.select ui.ui_surface: dev-only SurfaceRowGuard reads the page's surface row and the canvas surface row (one each)
_allowances.select communication.calendar_event / rp: agenda reads the mirror, refreshes from Google, then re-reads the mirror and its attendee edges (the second read sees the refreshed rows); on dashboard assoc_for_sources also reads the project tags
_allowances.select content_ir.kind_definition / kind: one shape's page: registry catalog read in two 1000-row pages plus distinct per-shape reads (home, readiness, fix-it diagnosis, cold-tier definition, owner editor) each selecting different columns; a shape with no component also runs the fix-it diagnosis
